product_metadata.title: Fox Run Rolling Pin Recipe Card Holder, 1.5 x 8.5 x 1.25 inches, Multicolored
features: Constructed of durable rubberwood with red painted handles
Holds your recipe card upright for easy reading
Looks and feels like a real wooden rolling pin
description: Love trying out new recipes? Easily follow step-by-step instructions, messy-hands-free! Fox Run's Rolling Pin Recipe Card Holder is perfect for bakers and chefs alike. Made of solid rubberwood with red painted handles, this adorable, unique piece looks and feels just like a wooden rolling pin! The convenient slot will hold your recipe card upright at the just the right angle for easy reading. A charming decoration when not being used, this holder is also great for keeping your to-do lists handy (just use a 4x6 card!). Keep your favorite recipe cards neat and clean, for years of use.
